items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: In 100 patients after QT-ACLR, 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI scores significantly predicted 2-year IKDC scores (β = 3.9; Adj R2 = 0.36; P < .03), with patients achieving PASS having higher LSI scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究证实了早期四头肌等长肌力 LSI 评分在预测 QT-ACL 重建术后 2 年患者报告结局中的价值。你可以更早地将 LSI 纳入康复评估，并以此指导早期康复，尤其关注术后 3 个月四头肌力量的恢复。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌肌腱自体移植 ACL 重建术后早期肢体对称性指数评分与 2 年患者报告结局的关联。
items.summaryZh: 在 100 例股四头肌肌腱自体移植 ACL 重建术后患者中，术后 3 个月的四头肌等长肌力肢体对称性指数（LSI）评分与 2 年 IKDC 评分显著相关（β = 3.9；调整 R² = 0.36；P < 0.03），达到患者可接受症状状态（PASS）的患者具有更高的 LSI 评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study confirms the value of early isometric quadriceps strength LSI scores in predicting 2-year patient-reported outcomes after QT-ACLR. You can incorporate LSI into earlier rehabilitation assessments and guide early rehab, focusing on quadriceps strength recovery at 3 months post-op.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性病例系列，可能存在选择偏倚且缺乏对照组。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective case series may be subject to selection bias and lacks a control group.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=75) found high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises (UNGE) significantly improved ulnar motor nerve conduction velocity, CMAP amplitudes, and DASH scores compared to ESWT+UNGE or UNGE alone, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证据坐实了高强度激光治疗（HILT）联合尺神经滑动练习在改善烧伤后肘管综合征电生理和功能结局方面，优于体外冲击波（ESWT）或单独练习。这意味着 HILT 可能是你未来处理此类患者时，更优的一线理疗选择。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光治疗与体外冲击波治疗的电生理和功能反应比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=75）发现，高强度激光治疗（HILT）联合尺神经滑动练习（UNGE）在改善尺神经运动传导速度、复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）幅度和臂肩手功能障碍评分（DASH）方面，显著优于体外冲击波（ESWT）联合 UNGE 或单独 UNGE，且疗效在 12 周随访时仍保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT evidence confirms that high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises (UNGE) is superior to extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT) or UNGE alone for improving electrophysiological and functional outcomes in post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. This suggests HILT could be a superior first-line modality option for these patients.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间仅为 12 周，长期效果尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 12 weeks, and long-term effects require further validation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: In adolescent patients (n=97) after patellar stabilization surgery, an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 was found to be an independent predictor (odds ratio, 3.56; 95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033) for successful return to sport (78.3% achieved RTS).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，青少年髌骨稳定术后，ACL-RSI 量表评分≥59.2 是成功重返运动的独立预测因子。将其整合到你的术后康复评估中，可以更早识别需要额外心理支持的患者。
items.titleZh: 青少年髌骨稳定术后，心理准备能否预测成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对青少年髌骨稳定术后患者（n=97）的研究发现，ACL-RSI 评分≥59.2 是成功重返运动（78.3% 达到 RTS）的独立预测因子（优势比 3.56；95% CI 1.10-11.51；P = 0.033）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 is an independent predictor for successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescents. Integrating this into your postoperative rehabilitation assessment can help identify patients needing additional psychological support earlier.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study may be subject to selection bias and confounding factors.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring Austrian physiotherapists' perceptions of direct access, revealing moderate-to-high confidence in differential diagnosis but lower confidence in red-flag screening, along with legal and liability concerns.
items.curatedReason: 奥地利物理治疗师对直转入制度的看法，揭示了临床能力与政策实施之间的差距。这可以为你思考如何在现有执业框架下提升红旗征兆筛查和影像判读能力提供参考，以期推动未来直转入的落地。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊制度下物理治疗师对直转入的看法——一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了奥地利物理治疗师对直转入的看法，结果显示他们在鉴别诊断方面信心适中至高，但在红旗征兆筛查方面信心较低，同时存在法律和责任担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in Austria highlight gaps between clinical competence and policy implementation. This can inform your approach to enhancing red-flag screening and imaging interpretation within current practice, paving the way for future direct access.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果不具有普遍代表性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, and its findings may not be broadly generalizable.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: A review of physiotherapy approaches for persistent pelvic pain, focusing on evidence-based management strategies.
items.curatedReason: 处理慢性盆腔疼痛，整合多模式疗法是关键。这篇综述提醒我们，对于传统疗法效果不佳的患者，需要跳出单一生物力学视角的限制。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于持续性盆腔疼痛物理治疗方法的综述，重点关注循证管理策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: When managing persistent pelvic pain, adopting multimodal approaches is crucial. This review is a good reminder that for patients not responding to traditional therapies, you need to look beyond a purely biomechanical lens.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review found existing caregiver assessments after stroke inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health, suggesting a need for more comprehensive integration of these factors in future instruments.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述揭示了卒中早期护理中财务负担和非医疗健康因素评估的不足。它提醒你在评估卒中患者及其家庭照护者时，要更全面地考虑社会经济因素，以制定更具支持性的康复计划。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期照护角色形成中的财务负担、非医疗健康驱动因素：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述发现，卒中后现有照护者评估未能持续性地捕捉财务毒性和非医疗健康驱动因素，提示未来工具需更全面整合这些因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights inadequate assessment of financial burden and non-medical drivers of health in early stroke care. It reminds you to consider socioeconomic factors more comprehensively when evaluating stroke patients and their family caregivers, to develop more supportive rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本综述纳入的研究多为观察性研究，证据等级不高，可能存在发表偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The included studies in this scoping review are primarily observational, leading to a lower level of evidence and potential publication bias.

items.title: A Foundational Balance Training Exercise Program for People with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: This review discusses the foundational balance training needs for individuals with blindness or low vision, emphasizing the increased reliance on somatosensory and vestibular systems due to reduced visual input.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述强调了视觉障碍患者平衡训练的重要性，并指出了目前对这类人群平衡训练项目的不足。它提示你在设计视障患者康复方案时，应特别关注体感和前庭系统的代偿性训练，以提升他们的安全移动能力。
items.titleZh: 盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练方案
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述探讨了盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练需求，强调由于视觉输入减少，他们对体感和前庭系统的依赖性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights the importance of balance training for individuals with visual impairments and the current inadequacy of such programs. It suggests that when designing rehabilitation plans for visually impaired patients, you should specifically focus on compensatory training of the somatosensory and vestibular systems to improve their safe mobility.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Using Patient-Centered Outcomes Data to Support Reciprocal Learning and Improve Rehabilitation Care
items.summary: This article emphasizes the use of patient-centered outcomes (PCO) data to inform individual patient care and guide health system-level learning for optimizing rehabilitation outcomes, while acknowledging challenges in achieving systematic implementation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了利用以患者为中心的结局（PCO）数据来改善康复护理的重要性，特别是通过促进团队成员之间的透明度和沟通。
items.titleZh: 利用以患者为中心的结局数据支持互惠学习和改善康复护理
items.summaryZh: 本文强调了利用以患者为中心的结局（PCO）数据来指导个体患者护理和引导卫生系统层面的学习，以优化康复结局，同时也承认了在系统性实施方面存在的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the importance of using patient-centered outcomes (PCO) data to improve rehabilitation care, particularly by fostering transparency and communication among team members.
items.limitation: 文章指出了系统性地利用 PCO 数据可能面临的挑战，如活动孤岛化和沟通不畅。
items.limitationEn: The article points out challenges in systematically utilizing PCO data, such as siloed activities and poor communication.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in South Africa explored physiotherapists' experiences with chronic non-specific low back pain self-management, identifying six key themes and emphasizing the biopsychosocial model for effective patient-centered care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非物理治疗师在管理慢性非特异性腰痛患者时的经验和见解，强调了生物心理社会模型在制定有效的自我管理策略中的关键作用。
items.titleZh: 南非物理治疗师对非特异性慢性腰痛患者自我管理实践的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在南非进行的定性研究，探讨了物理治疗师在慢性非特异性腰痛自我管理方面的经验，确定了六个关键主题，并强调了生物心理社会模型在以患者为中心护理中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals the experiences and insights of physiotherapists in South Africa regarding the management of patients with chronic non-specific low back pain, emphasizing the crucial role of the biopsychosocial model in developing effective self-management strategies.
items.limitation: 研究设计为描述性、探索性定性研究，主要在南非利姆波波省进行，可能限制了结果的普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study design is descriptive and exploratory qualitative, conducted primarily in the Limpopo province of South Africa, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: An appraisal of a clinical practice guideline for physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder is presented.
items.curatedReason: 对儿科物理治疗管理发育协调障碍的临床实践指南进行了评估，为该领域的研究和实践提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：儿童发育协调障碍的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 对儿科物理治疗管理发育协调障碍的临床实践指南进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an appraisal of a clinical practice guideline for the physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder, providing reference for research and practice in the field.

items.title: Clarifying 'youth: why conceptual and ethical clarity matters in sport
items.summary: An editorial discusses the variability in terminology used to define 'youth' athletes, highlighting conceptual and ethical issues that impact research, policy, and practice in sport.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论强调了在青年体育领域，对“青年”一词的概念和伦理清晰性的重要性，这与运动康复领域相关。
items.titleZh: 澄清“青年”：为何在体育运动中概念和伦理的清晰性至关重要
items.summaryZh: 一篇社论讨论了青年运动员术语使用中的概念和伦理问题，强调了清晰界定“青年”一词对体育研究、政策和实践的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights the importance of conceptual and ethical clarity regarding the term 'youth' in youth sport, which is relevant to sports rehabilitation.

items.title: Championing choice: the Womens Tennis Association Fertility Protection Programme for professional women tennis players
items.summary: The Women's Tennis Association's Fertility Protection Programme aims to address the challenges professional women tennis players face regarding fertility preservation and parenthood.
items.curatedReason: 文章讨论了女子网球运动员的生育保护计划，涉及女性健康和运动康复交叉领域，具有一定参考价值。
items.titleZh: 倡导选择：女子网球协会的生育保护计划为职业女子网球运动员
items.summaryZh: 女子网球协会的生育保护计划旨在解决职业女子网球运动员在生育保护和为人父母方面面临的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article discusses the Fertility Protection Programme for female tennis players, touching upon women's health and sports rehabilitation, making it somewhat relevant.

items.title: 'Written in English: has English as the lingua franca of mental health research in sport and parasport become a barrier to creating culturally and contextually situated mental health care?
items.summary: A commentary argues that English as the lingua franca in sport and parasport mental health research may create linguistic inequalities and hinder the development of culturally situated mental healthcare, proposing greater linguistic inclusivity.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章讨论了英语作为体育和残疾人体育领域心理健康研究的通用语所带来的语言不平等问题，对于理解跨文化康复实践有一定启发。
items.titleZh: 用英语书写：英语作为体育和残疾人体育领域心理健康研究的通用语是否已成为创造文化和情境化心理健康护理的障碍？
items.summaryZh: 一篇评论认为，英语作为体育和残疾人体育领域心理健康研究的通用语可能会造成语言不平等，并阻碍具有文化和情境化心理健康护理的发展，因此提议提高语言包容性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary discusses linguistic inequalities arising from English as the lingua franca in mental health research in sport and parasport, offering insights into cross-cultural rehabilitation practices.

items.title: Implementation gap: a 3-year reality check in body composition monitoring in sport
items.summary: This editorial addresses the implementation gap in body composition monitoring in sport, aiming to promote the integration of evidence-informed recommendations into practice to safeguard athlete health.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章讨论了体育领域身体成分监测的实施差距，与运动康复中的运动员健康管理相关。
items.titleZh: 实施差距：体育界身体成分监测的三年现实检验
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论讨论了体育界身体成分监测的实施差距，旨在促进将循证建议融入实践，以保障运动员的健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article discusses the implementation gap in body composition monitoring in sport, relevant to athlete health management in sports rehabilitation.

items.title: 'Avoid vigorous exercise until further notice: recovery after cholesteatoma surgery
items.summary: The author recounts their experience and concerns following cholesteatoma surgery, highlighting the lack of clear guidance on restrictions like avoiding vigorous exercise and its impact on their identity as a powerlifter and PhD student.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章的作者分享了胆脂瘤手术后避免剧烈运动的个人经历，这对于理解运动限制的患者康复和生活重建具有参考价值。
items.titleZh: “暂停剧烈运动，直至另行通知”：胆脂瘤手术后的恢复
items.summaryZh: 作者回顾了胆脂瘤手术后的经历和担忧，强调了关于避免剧烈运动等限制的明确指导的缺失，以及这对他们作为举重运动员和博士生的身份的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The author shares a personal experience of avoiding strenuous exercise after cholesteatoma surgery, which provides relevance for understanding patient rehabilitation and life adjustments with exercise restrictions.

items.title: Influence of shoulder strength on throwing velocity in handball (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD thesis aimed to define how comprehensive shoulder strength profiles influence throwing velocity in handball players by developing and validating a functional shoulder dynamogram.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，全面的肩部力量评估可能与手球运动员的投掷速度相关。在评估和提高运动员投掷表现时，不应只关注单块肌肉，而是要着眼于整体肩部肌群的协同作用。
items.titleZh: 肩部力量对手球掷球速度的影响（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 该博士论文旨在通过开发和验证功能性肩部测力计，来定义全面的肩部力量特征对手球运动员掷球速度的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that comprehensive shoulder strength profiles may correlate with throwing velocity in handball players. When assessing and improving throwing performance, you should consider the synergistic function of the entire shoulder musculature, not just isolated muscles.
items.limitation: 该研究使用新开发的测力计，其可靠性和有效性有待进一步验证；样本量和运动水平的代表性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The study uses a newly developed dynamometer, the reliability and validity of which may require further validation; the sample size and representation of competitive levels might be limited.

items.title: Sex differences in performance fatigability: evidence from a maximal intermittent protocol using a flywheel device (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD thesis investigated sex differences in performance fatigability following a maximal intermittent fatiguing protocol using a flywheel device, examining effects on reliability, performance decline, and muscle activity.
items.curatedReason: 这篇关于性别在运动表现疲劳方面的差异的博士论文摘要，对于理解不同性别运动员的康复和训练策略有价值。
items.titleZh: 性别在表现疲劳方面的差异：来自飞轮设备最大间歇性方案的证据（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 该博士论文研究了使用飞轮设备的最大间歇性方案后，性别在表现疲劳方面的差异，考察了对可靠性、表现下降和肌肉活动的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD abstract on sex differences in performance fatigability offers value in understanding rehabilitation and training strategies for athletes of different sexes.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于最大间歇性疲劳方案和飞轮设备，结果的外推性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to a maximal intermittent fatiguing protocol using a flywheel device, potentially limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Development of an upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD thesis aimed to propose a stakeholder-informed upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework to enhance clinician/researcher and athlete interaction.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究开发了一个用于评估运动员四肢疼痛的框架，对运动康复中的疼痛管理具有直接意义。
items.titleZh: 上、下肢运动员疼痛评估框架的开发（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 该博士论文旨在提出一个由利益相关者参与制定的上、下肢运动员疼痛评估框架，以加强临床医生/研究人员与运动员之间的互动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pain assessment framework highlights the necessity of integrating multiple perspectives—athletes, clinicians, and researchers—when addressing athlete pain. This can help you more comprehensively understand and manage upper and lower limb pain in athletes, rather than merely treating symptoms.
items.limitation: 该框架是基于利益相关者的信息开发的，其在不同运动项目和文化背景下的验证和适用性有待进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The framework was developed based on stakeholder input; its validation and applicability across different sports and cultural contexts require further investigation.

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) released a clinical practice guideline using the GRADE approach to address rehabilitation interventions for hamstring strain injury in athletes, synthesizing evidence from randomized clinical trials.
items.curatedReason: 巴西运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了使用 GRADE 方法制定的腘绳肌拉伤运动员康复临床实践指南。这份指南提供了基于随机对照试验的最新证据，是你在处理这类运动损伤时，优化临床决策的关键参考。
items.titleZh: 腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复：SONAFE-Brazil 临床实践指南。
items.summaryZh: 巴西运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了一项使用 GRADE 方法制定的临床实践指南，旨在指导腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复干预，该指南综合了随机临床试验的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) has published a clinical practice guideline for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation in athletes, developed using the GRADE approach. This guideline offers an updated, evidence-based synthesis from randomized clinical trials, crucial for optimizing clinical decision-making when managing such sports injuries.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: This theoretical paper proposes the Hands-On Data Acquisition and Analysis (HODA-A) framework for conceptualizing hands-on musculoskeletal examination as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process, applying COSMIN principles to establish a foundation for validation research.
items.curatedReason: 这项理论框架论文提出了将手法评估视为临床医生报告结果测量过程的“HODA-A”框架。它并非评判具体手法技术，而是试图建立一套测量学标准，理解其如何应用COSMIN原则构建可信的手法评估体系，将有助于你更严谨地解读和应用肌骨手法评估。
items.titleZh: 将徒手肌肉骨骼评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术争议：应用 COSMIN 到 HODA-A 的理论框架。
items.summaryZh: 这篇理论文章提出了“徒手数据采集与分析（HODA-A）”框架，将徒手肌肉骨骼检查概念化为一种临床医生报告的结果测量过程，并应用 COSMIN 原则为验证研究奠定基础。
items.curatedReasonEn: This theoretical framework paper introduces the “HODA-A” framework, conceptualizing hands-on assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process, rather than debating the merits of specific manual techniques. Understanding how it applies COSMIN principles to build a credible manual assessment system will help you more rigorously interpret and apply musculoskeletal hands-on assessments.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 30 chronic stroke hemiplegia patients found that thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF all p < 0.001), inspiratory muscle strength (MIP p < 0.001), and functional independence (FIM p = 0.029) compared to sham taping.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴布（KT）联合常规康复能显著改善慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF 均 p < 0.001）和吸气肌力（MIP p < 0.001），并提升功能独立性。虽然对呼气肌力无显著影响，但胸部 KT 可作为呼吸神经康复的实用辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴布对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名慢性卒中偏瘫患者的随机对照试验发现，胸部肌内效贴布（KT）结合常规康复治疗，与假贴布相比，显著改善了肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF 均 p < 0.001）、吸气肌力（MIP p < 0.001）和功能独立性（FIM p = 0.029）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF all p < 0.001) and inspiratory muscle strength (MIP p < 0.001), and enhances functional independence in chronic stroke hemiplegia patients. Although it has no significant effect on expiratory muscle strength, thoracic KT can serve as a practical adjunct in respiratory neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短（4 周），无法评估胸部肌内效贴布的长期效果及其在不同卒中阶段的适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period (4 weeks), preventing evaluation of the long-term effects of thoracic kinesiology taping and its applicability in different stroke stages.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 81 cervicogenic headache patients found that both kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise significantly improved pain, disability, quality of life, and headache frequency compared to home exercise alone. MFR showed more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴布 (KT) 和肌筋膜松解术 (MFR) 联合家庭锻炼，均能有效短期减轻颈源性头痛患者的疼痛和头痛频率。MFR 在残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善，如果你需要为患者提供长期康复策略，MFR 可能是一个更优的选择。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布与肌筋膜松解术治疗颈源性头痛的比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 81 名颈源性头痛患者的随机对照试验发现，肌内效贴布（KT）和肌筋膜松解术（MFR）联合家庭锻炼，与单纯家庭锻炼相比，均显著改善了疼痛、残疾、生活质量和头痛频率。MFR 在残疾和身体生活质量方面表现出更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise are both effective in short-term pain and headache frequency reduction for cervicogenic headache patients. MFR provided more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life, making it a potentially superior choice if you need to provide long-term rehabilitation strategies for patients.
items.limitation: 研究随访期较短（仅一个月），无法充分评估两种干预措施的长期疗效和复发率。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period (only one month), which is insufficient to fully assess the long-term efficacy and recurrence rates of both interventions.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicentre randomized controlled trial showed that a smartphone-based multidisciplinary intervention combining personalized exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy significantly improved pain, function, quality of life, and psychological well-being in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 一项多中心 RCT 证实，结合运动和认知行为疗法（CBT）的数字疗法能显著改善慢性髌股疼痛（PFP）患者的疼痛、功能和生活质量。这意味着你可以利用这种可扩展、成本效益高的数字工具，为 PFP 患者提供更全面的整合治疗，尤其是在资源受限的环境下。
items.titleZh: 结合运动和认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验显示，一项结合个性化运动和认知行为疗法的智能手机多学科干预显著改善了慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛、功能、生活质量和心理健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: A multicenter RCT confirms that a digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) significantly improves pain, function, and quality of life in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain (PFP). This means you can leverage such scalable, cost-effective digital tools to provide more comprehensive integrated treatment for PFP patients, especially in resource-limited settings.
items.limitation: 数字疗法对患者依从性的长期影响及与传统面对面干预相比的非劣效性，仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The long-term impact of digital therapeutics on patient adherence and their non-inferiority compared to traditional in-person interventions still require further research.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved upper limb motor function (FMA-UE MD=3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69) and shoulder/elbow muscle strength compared to sham taVNS.
items.curatedReason: 卒中康复中，taVNS联合上肢练习可显著改善慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢运动功能和肌力（FMA-UE 改善 3.95分）。这项RCT提示taVNS是可行的辅助干预手段，但需注意FMA-UE的改善幅度未达公认的最小临床重要差异。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，经皮耳迷走神经刺激 (taVNS) 联合上肢练习与假性 taVNS 相比，显著改善了慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能（FMA-UE MD=3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69）以及肩部和肘部肌肉力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: In stroke rehabilitation, transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved upper limb motor function and strength (FMA-UE improved by 3.95 points) in chronic ischemic stroke patients. This RCT suggests taVNS is a viable adjunct intervention, but note that the FMA-UE improvement did not reach the widely accepted minimal clinically important difference.
items.limitation: FMA-UE 评分改善的 95% 置信区间低于报告的最小临床重要差异，其临床相关性需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The 95% CI for FMA-UE score improvement was below the reported minimal clinically important difference, so its clinical relevance should be interpreted cautiously.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 216 elite TeamGym gymnasts established the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance, showing senior males outperformed junior males and senior females in hop outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究提供了精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的下肢功能测试性别和年龄特异性常模。未来在康复和重返赛场评估中，这些常模可作为参考，但需警惕其普遍适用性，因其仅代表特定运动人群。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢现场测试的性别和年龄特异性常模。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 216 名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的横断面研究首次建立了下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模，结果显示高级组男性在跳跃测试中表现优于初级组男性和高级组女性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study provides sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts. While these norms can serve as a reference in future rehabilitation and return-to-sport evaluations, be cautious about their generalizability as they only represent a specific athletic population.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法追踪这些常模在训练或伤病恢复过程中的动态变化，且仅限于 TeamGym 这一特定运动类型。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design cannot track dynamic changes in these norms during training or injury recovery, and it is limited to the specific sport of TeamGym.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction in football players: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort analysis found that for players who returned to competition, graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) was not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction, for both men and women.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模全国队列分析发现，对于重返赛场的足球运动员，移植物类型（腘绳肌、髌腱或股四头肌自移植物）与翻修 ACL 重建的风险无关。这意味着你在 ACLR 移植物选择时，可以更多地考虑患者特征和外科医生偏好，而不必过度担忧翻修风险。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员 ACL 翻修重建无关：一项全国性后续 ACL 重建队列分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项全国性队列分析发现，对于重返赛场的足球运动员，移植物类型（腘绳肌、髌腱或股四头肌自移植物）与男性和女性的 ACL 翻修重建风险均无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large nationwide cohort analysis found that for football players returning to competition, graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) was not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction. This means you can prioritize patient characteristics and surgeon preference when selecting an ACLR graft, without undue concern about revision risk.
items.limitation: 研究数据来自全国队列，可能存在未调整的混杂因素，且未能评估移植物类型对首次 ACLR 失败风险的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study used nationwide cohort data, which may have unadjusted confounders and did not assess the impact of graft type on the risk of primary ACLR failure.

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative secondary analysis explored neurorehabilitation patients' perceptions of fundamental care needs, identifying physical, psychosocial, and relational dimensions as interconnected and crucial for dignity and recovery, extending beyond task-based models.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调，神经康复患者对“基本照护”的需求远超物理任务，还包括心理社会和关系维度。这意味着你的康复计划和团队协作必须把尊重的沟通、情感支持和持续在场视为核心，而不仅仅是功能训练。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待他们的基本照护需求？一项定性研究的结果。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性二次分析探讨了神经康复患者对基本照护需求的感知，发现物理、心理社会和关系维度相互关联，对患者的尊严和康复至关重要，超越了基于任务的模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study emphasizes that neurorehabilitation patients' “fundamental care” needs extend far beyond physical tasks, encompassing psychosocial and relational dimensions. This means your rehabilitation plans and team collaboration must prioritize respectful communication, emotional support, and continuous presence, not just functional training.
items.limitation: 研究为定性二次分析，受访者来自意大利一家康复医院，结果推广至其他文化和医疗体系可能需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is a qualitative secondary analysis, with participants from a rehabilitation hospital in Italy, so generalizing results to other cultures and healthcare systems may require caution.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 12,797 older adults from the NHATS (2011-2024) found that stroke history was independently associated with a higher prevalence of bothersome pain (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38) among community-dwelling older adults in the USA.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模横断面分析证实，卒中史与社区老年人更普遍的困扰性疼痛和活动受限性疼痛独立相关（困扰性疼痛 OR 1.30；活动受限性疼痛 OR 1.20）。在老年卒中患者康复中，应把疼痛评估和管理提升到更优先的位置。
items.titleZh: 美国社区居住卒中老年人与非卒中老年人的困扰性及活动受限性疼痛：对国家健康与老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 NHATS 研究（2011-2024）中 12,797 名老年人的横断面分析发现，在美国社区居住的老年人中，卒中病史与困扰性疼痛（OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66）和活动受限性疼痛（OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38）的较高流行率独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-scale cross-sectional analysis confirms that a history of stroke is independently associated with a higher prevalence of bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults (bothersome pain OR 1.30; activity-limiting pain OR 1.20). Pain assessment and management should be prioritized in geriatric stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系，且疼痛数据为患者自述。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality between stroke and pain, and pain data is self-reported by patients.

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: An action-research study developed and piloted "Let's Move," an early exercise program for hospitalized patients, showing 76.5% adherence among evaluable participants and 96.2% achieving individualized goals with no adverse events, supporting its feasibility and safety.
items.curatedReason: “Let's Move”项目是一项在住院患者中实施的早期运动计划，旨在减少医院相关失调。这个项目结合了患者教育和低强度运动，76.5% 的患者表现出依从性，96.2% 达到了个性化目标。你在住院患者的早期康复管理中可以借鉴其设计和流程，以提升患者移动性。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的设计。
items.summaryZh: 一项行动研究开发并试点实施了住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”，结果显示，在可评估的参与者中，依从性达到 76.5%，96.2% 的患者实现了个性化目标，未发生不良事件，证明了其可行性和安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The "Let's Move" program is an early exercise program implemented in hospitalized patients to reduce hospital-associated deconditioning. This program combines patient education with low-intensity exercise, showing 76.5% patient adherence and 96.2% achievement of individualized goals. You can adapt its design and workflow to enhance patient mobility in early inpatient rehabilitation management.
items.limitation: 该研究为试点实施，样本量较小（26 例），且评估依从性的受试者只有 17 例，其结果的普适性需要更大规模的评估来验证。
items.limitationEn: This study was a pilot implementation with a small sample size (26 participants), and only 17 were evaluable for adherence, so the generalizability of its findings requires larger-scale evaluation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: This study, the first to use direct measures, found that moderate-to-vigorous intensity cycling exercise was well tolerated by both mothers and fetuses in singleton and twin pregnancies, with few differences in maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses, providing evidence to inform exercise advice for twin pregnancies.
items.curatedReason: 这项首次使用直接测量方法的研究发现，中高强度运动对单胎和双胎妊娠的母儿心血管反应影响不大，且耐受性良好。你可以依据此证据，更自信地指导双胎妊娠孕妇进行适度运动。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中，中高强度运动对母体和胎儿心血管反应的影响。
items.summaryZh: 这项首次使用直接测量方法的研究发现，中高强度循环运动在单胎和双胎妊娠中，母体和胎儿均能良好耐受，且心血管反应差异不大，为双胎妊娠的运动建议提供了证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study, using direct measures for the first time, found that moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise had minimal impact on maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses in both singleton and twin pregnancies, with good tolerance. You can use this evidence to more confidently guide pregnant individuals with twin gestations to engage in moderate exercise.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是急性运动反应，缺乏长期随访数据来评估中高强度运动对双胎妊娠结局的持续影响。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on acute exercise responses and lacked long-term follow-up data to assess the sustained impact of moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise on twin pregnancy outcomes.

items.title: Time to act: why menopause should be a priority in sports and exercise medicine
items.summary: This review highlights menopause as a priority in sports and exercise medicine, noting its significant impact on female athletes' physical performance, musculoskeletal pain, and overall health beyond just bone mass loss and cardiovascular risks.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章提醒你，更年期对女性运动员的表现和健康有显著影响，这不仅体现在骨密度和心血管风险上，也包括肌肉骨骼疼痛和体力下降。你在评估和管理女性运动员时，应将更年期因素纳入考量，提供更全面的支持。
items.titleZh: 刻不容缓：为何更年期应成为运动与康复医学的优先事项。
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述强调更年期应成为运动与康复医学的优先事项，指出其对女性运动员的身体表现、肌肉骨骼疼痛和整体健康具有显著影响，超越了骨量流失和心血管风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article reminds you that menopause significantly impacts female athletes' performance and health, not only in bone density and cardiovascular risk but also in musculoskeletal pain and physical decline. You should consider menopausal factors when assessing and managing female athletes to provide more comprehensive support.

items.title: Client Challenge
items.summary: An umbrella review of 28 meta-analyses found that exercise-containing interventions consistently supported improvements in muscle function and physical performance in older adults, particularly for fall-related outcomes. Nutrition-only interventions showed modest benefits for muscle mass in selected vulnerable populations, while combined interventions improved some strength and functional outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述有力地支持了运动干预在改善老年人肌肉功能和身体表现方面的作用，尤其是对跌倒相关结局。你可以自信地推荐以运动为基础的预防策略，但对纯营养干预的益处则要谨慎。
items.titleZh: 运动、营养和联合干预对老年人肌肉功能和身体表现的证据可信度和强度：一项随机对照试验荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 项荟萃分析的伞形综述发现，包含运动的干预措施在改善老年人肌肉功能和身体表现方面始终有证据支持，尤其是在跌倒相关结局方面。纯营养干预在特定脆弱人群的肌肉量方面显示出适度益处，而联合干预则改善了一些力量和功能结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strongly supports the role of exercise interventions in improving muscle function and physical performance in older adults, especially for fall-related outcomes. You can confidently recommend exercise-based prevention strategies, but be cautious about the benefits of nutrition-only interventions.
items.limitation: 纳入的系统综述存在方法学质量混杂（18 项低或极低质量），且存在综述重叠和临床异质性，部分大效应量来自小样本研究，结果解释需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The included systematic reviews had mixed methodological quality (18 low or critically low quality), with review overlap and clinical heterogeneity. Some large effect sizes came from small sample studies, requiring cautious interpretation.

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month randomized controlled trial (N=68) found that supervised multicomponent telerehabilitation combining Pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, depressive symptoms, and perceived stress (p < 0.001 to 0.028) compared to usual care, with 87.5% adherence and no adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 为期 6 个月的远程多组分干预（普拉提结合自我筋膜松解）显著改善了纤维肌痛患者的症状影响、睡眠质量、抑郁症状和感知压力。你可以将其作为纤维肌痛患者常规治疗的有力补充，尤其对于可远程指导的患者。
items.titleZh: 普拉提治疗性运动与自我筋膜松解相结合的六个月远程康复对纤维肌痛成人患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 6 个月的随机对照试验（N=68）发现，与常规护理相比，结合普拉提治疗性运动和自我筋膜松解的多组分远程康复显著改善了纤维肌痛的影响、睡眠质量、抑郁症状和感知压力（p < 0.001 至 0.028），依从性达 87.5%，无不良事件报告。
items.curatedReasonEn: A 6-month telerehabilitation intervention combining Pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, depressive symptoms, and perceived stress in adults with fibromyalgia. You can consider this as a strong complement to conventional treatment for fibromyalgia patients, especially those suitable for remote guidance.
items.limitation: 干预组与常规护理组在焦虑症状上无显著差异，且该研究为单中心试验，结果可能受到地域和具体实施条件的影响。
items.limitationEn: There were no significant differences in anxiety symptoms between the intervention and usual care groups, and this was a single-center trial, so results may be influenced by geography and specific implementation conditions.

items.title: The role of core stability training in improving balance and poomsae technique quality in taekwondo poomsae athletes with neuromuscular control deficits with trunk involvement: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An 8-week randomized controlled trial (N=29 male taekwondo athletes) found that core stability training significantly improved static and dynamic balance, trunk muscle endurance (ηp² = 0.38–0.84, P < 0.001), and some sport-specific performance measures compared to regular training.
items.curatedReason: 核心稳定性训练能显著提高跆拳道品势运动员的平衡和躯干肌肉耐力，并对特定运动表现有额外改善。对于你需要训练的、有躯干神经肌肉控制缺陷的爆发性运动项目运动员，可以把核心训练纳入其常规方案。
items.titleZh: 核心稳定性训练在改善躯干受累神经肌肉控制缺陷的跆拳道品势运动员平衡和品势技术质量中的作用：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的随机对照试验（N=29 名男性跆拳道运动员）发现，核心稳定性训练显著改善了静态和动态平衡、躯干肌肉耐力（ηp² = 0.38–0.84, P < 0.001）以及一些运动特异性表现指标，优于常规训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: Core stability training significantly improved balance and trunk muscle endurance in taekwondo poomsae athletes, with additional improvements in selected sport-specific performance. For athletes with trunk neuromuscular control deficits in explosive sports, you can incorporate core training into their regular programs.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（29 名男性运动员），且集中于特定人群和运动类型，结果推广至其他人群和运动时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study had a relatively small sample size (29 male athletes) and focused on a specific population and sport type, so the results should be generalized with caution to other populations and sports.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary study (N=7 chronic stroke) found that a single session of high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises increased FDS MEP amplitudes by ~22.3% in chronic stroke, though not statistically significant, suggesting potential for enhancing corticospinal excitability.
items.curatedReason: HD-tACS 联合机器人辅助手部练习有望提高卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。这为卒中康复的辅助手段提供了新的方向，但仍需更大规模的研究来验证其临床意义。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部练习对慢性卒中患者皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究（N=7 慢性卒中患者）发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部练习使慢性卒中患者的指深屈肌（FDS）运动诱发电位（MEP）振幅增加了约 22.3%，尽管未达统计学显著性，但提示其具有增强皮质脊髓兴奋性的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: HD-tACS combined with robot-assisted hand exercises shows promise in enhancing corticospinal excitability in stroke patients. This offers a new direction for adjunctive stroke rehabilitation, but larger studies are needed to confirm its clinical significance.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步研究，样本量小（7 名慢性卒中患者），且未达到统计学显著性，需要更大规模研究的证实。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary study with a small sample size (7 chronic stroke individuals), and the change was not statistically significant, requiring confirmation by larger studies.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of 511 female and male athletes (pre-injury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7) undergoing primary ACL-R found that 62% achieved a Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 within 24 months, with an average duration of 12.3 months (SD 4.7), but only 51% returned to their pre-injury sport levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了 ACL 重建术后重返高强度运动的长期随访数据，显示 62% 的高活跃度运动员可在 24 个月内恢复到受伤前的 Tegner 评分，但只有 51% 实际恢复。了解这些真实数据，有助于你与患者进行更切合实际的期望管理。
items.titleZh: Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的运动员初次前交叉韧带重建术后重返运动：一项纵向全国性注册研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 511 名初次接受 ACL 重建术、受伤前 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的男女运动员的全国性队列研究发现，62% 的患者在 24 个月内达到了 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7，平均用时 12.3 个月 (SD 4.7)，但只有 51% 的人实际回到了受伤前的运动水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides long-term follow-up data for return to high-level sport after ACL reconstruction, showing 62% of highly active athletes achieved pre-injury Tegner scores within 24 months, but only 51% actually returned. Understanding these real-world figures will help you manage patient expectations more realistically.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的运动员，结果对外推到其他活动水平的患者可能有限制。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on athletes with a Tegner Activity Scale score of ≥7, which may limit generalizability to patients with other activity levels.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative study found that elite Para athletes face pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations during pregnancy and postpartum, leading to inconsistent guidance and heightened uncertainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了精英残疾运动员在怀孕和产后阶段面临的独特挑战，包括教练和医疗服务提供者的知识空白以及缺乏残疾友好型支持。你应注意这些群体的特殊需求，避免忽视其康复和运动表现支持。
items.titleZh: 精英残疾运动员怀孕和产后经历的考察：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究发现，精英残疾运动员在怀孕和产后期间面临教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织普遍存在的残疾特异性知识空白，导致指导不一致和不确定性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals the unique challenges faced by elite Para athletes during pregnancy and postpartum, including knowledge gaps among coaches and healthcare providers, and a lack of disability-inclusive support. You should be mindful of these specific needs to avoid overlooking their rehabilitation and performance support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性描述性研究，样本量未具体说明，结果可能无法推广到所有残疾运动员群体。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative descriptive study with an unspecified sample size, and the findings may not be generalizable to all Para athlete populations.

items.title: Factors associated with 1-year health-related quality of life after neck-specific exercise in chronic whiplash-associated disorders: an exploratory secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT (N=140) in chronic whiplash-associated disorders found that improvements in psychosocial measures, pain, and disability were associated with improvements in HRQoL at 3 and 15 months after neck-specific exercise, with higher baseline psychosocial distress and disability also associated with clinically relevant HRQoL improvement at 15 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项对慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者的研究提示，除颈部特异性运动外，社会心理因素和功能障碍程度也可能影响一年后的健康相关生活质量。在治疗中，你应同时关注患者的心理健康和功能表现。
items.titleZh: 慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者颈部特异性运动后 1 年健康相关生活质量的相关因素：一项随机对照试验的探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者的 RCT 二次分析（N=140）发现，社会心理测量、疼痛和残疾的改善与颈部特异性运动后 3 个月和 15 个月健康相关生活质量的改善相关，基线社会心理困扰和残疾程度较高也与 15 个月时健康相关生活质量的临床显著改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on patients with chronic whiplash-associated disorders suggests that psychosocial factors and the degree of disability, in addition to neck-specific exercises, may influence health-related quality of life after one year. In your treatment, you should concurrently address patients' mental health and functional performance.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性二次分析，模型的预测能力较弱（R² = 0.20-0.27, Q² = 0.06-0.13），结果应被视为假设生成。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory secondary analysis with weak predictive ability of the models (R² = 0.20-0.27, Q² = 0.06-0.13), and the findings should be considered hypothesis-generating.

items.title: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of football players undergoing primary ACL-R (mean follow-up 5.2 years) found no association between autograft type (hamstring, patellar, or quadriceps tendon) and revision ACLR risk. However, quadriceps tendon was associated with a higher hazard of contralateral ACLR in women (HR 1.98, 95% CI 1.17 to 3.36).
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究显示，足球运动员 ACL 重建术后的移植物类型与翻修手术风险无关，但年轻和高水平运动员后续受伤风险更高。这提示你，在与足球运动员讨论 ACL 康复和风险管理时，重点应放在年龄和运动水平，而非移植物选择上。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员前交叉韧带翻修重建无关：一项全国性队列分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后的全国性队列研究（平均随访 5.2 年）发现，自体移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱）与翻修 ACL 重建风险无关。然而，女性中股四头肌腱与对侧 ACL 重建的较高风险相关（HR 1.98，95% CI 1.17 至 3.36）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide cohort study indicates that graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction risk in football players, but younger age and higher pre-injury activity levels are consistently linked to greater subsequent injury risk. This suggests that when discussing ACL rehabilitation and risk management with football players, your focus should be on age and activity level, rather than graft choice.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是翻修 ACL 重建和对侧 ACL 重建，未评估移植物类型与功能恢复或重返运动表现等其他临床结局的关系。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on revision ACL reconstruction and contralateral ACL reconstruction, and did not evaluate the relationship between graft type and other clinical outcomes such as functional recovery or return-to-sport performance.

items.title:
Rhythm-centred music interventions for motor coordination and rehabilitation: a scoping review of mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A scoping review of 63 studies on rhythm-centered music interventions for motor coordination and rehabilitation found that coordination-related tasks were the most common targets, with rhythm being the most frequently used musical element, and technology-assisted assessment being prevalent. The interventions were heterogeneous, highlighting the need for improved terminology and methodological transparency in future studies.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述提供了以节律为中心、基于音乐的运动干预机制、设计原则及技术辅助评估的证据。它提示你，在神经康复中可以考虑利用音乐和节律来提升运动协调性，但仍需注意其异质性。
items.titleZh: 以节律为中心的音乐干预在运动协调和康复中的应用：机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 63 项以节律为中心的音乐干预在运动协调和康复中应用的研究范围综述发现，协调相关任务是最常见的目标，节律是最常用的音乐元素，技术辅助评估普遍存在。这些干预措施具有异质性，强调未来研究需改进术语和方法学透明度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review provides evidence on the mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment of rhythm-centered, music-based motor interventions. It suggests that you can consider using music and rhythm to enhance motor coordination in neurological rehabilitation, while still being mindful of its heterogeneity.
items.limitation: 该综述纳入的研究具有高度异质性，因此其发现应被视为描述性证据模式，而非治疗效果的明确估计。
items.limitationEn: The included studies in this review are highly heterogeneous, so the findings should be interpreted as descriptive evidence patterns rather than definitive estimates of therapeutic efficacy.

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 28 pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation found that reporting quality averaged 6.1 out of 11 points, and only 3 studies (12%) progressed to a definitive RCT, with lack of funding being the main barrier.
items.curatedReason: 卒中康复领域中的初步研究和可行性研究报告质量仍需提高，且只有少数研究能成功推进到确证性 RCT。这提醒你在评估新干预措施时，要仔细审视其初步证据的报告质量和后续转化潜力。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中的初步研究和可行性研究：报告质量、试验进展和障碍：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 项卒中康复初步研究和可行性研究的范围综述发现，报告质量平均为 11 分中的 6.1 分，仅 3 项研究（12%）进展为确证性随机对照试验，主要障碍是缺乏资金。
items.curatedReasonEn: The reporting quality of pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation needs improvement, and only a small fraction progress to definitive RCTs. This highlights the importance of scrutinizing the reporting quality and translational potential of preliminary evidence when evaluating new interventions.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，主要关注研究的报告质量和转化情况，未对具体干预措施的疗效进行评估。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, the focus is on reporting quality and trial progression, not on evaluating the efficacy of specific interventions.

items.title: Georges Gymnastics Program: scaling an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training centre partnership
items.summary: The Georges Gymnastics Program successfully scaled an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training center partnership, addressing barriers to sport participation for this vulnerable group.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究介绍了与奥运训练中心合作，为智力障碍儿童扩展融合性体操服务的成功案例。该模式可能为你的社区康复或与当地体育机构合作提供思路，以更好地服务特殊儿童群体。
items.titleZh: Georges 体操项目：通过与奥运训练中心合作，为智力障碍儿童扩展融合性学校体操服务
items.summaryZh: Georges 体操项目通过与奥运训练中心合作，成功扩展了针对智力障碍儿童的融合性校本体操服务，解决了这一弱势群体在参与体育运动中面临的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study presents a successful case of scaling an inclusive gymnastics service for children with intellectual disabilities through a partnership with an Olympic training center. This model could inspire your community rehabilitation efforts or collaborations with local sports organizations to better serve children with special needs.
items.limitation: 该研究描述的是特定项目的推广经验，属于观察性研究，未进行对照组比较，其有效性需要更严格的评估。
items.limitationEn: This study describes the expansion experience of a specific program and is an observational study without a control group, so its effectiveness requires more rigorous evaluation.

items.title: Endometriosis and elite sports: a blind spot in research
items.summary: This commentary highlights endometriosis, a chronic inflammatory disease affecting over 10% of women of reproductive age, as a striking blind spot in sports research, despite its potential impact on elite female athletes' daily functioning, training, recovery, and performance.
items.curatedReason: 这项述评指出子宫内膜异位症在精英运动员研究中被忽视，它提醒你女性健康在运动康复领域仍有诸多盲点。在评估和管理女性运动员时，应更全面地考虑其潜在的生殖健康问题，例如慢性疼痛对训练和表现的影响。
items.titleZh: 子宫内膜异位症与精英运动：研究盲点
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论指出子宫内膜异位症（一种影响超过 10% 育龄女性的慢性炎症性疾病）在运动研究中是一个显著的盲点，尽管它可能影响精英女运动员的日常功能、训练、恢复和表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the neglect of endometriosis in elite athlete research, reminding you that women's health still has many blind spots in sports rehabilitation. When assessing and managing female athletes, you should more comprehensively consider their potential reproductive health issues, such as the impact of chronic pain on training and performance.
items.limitation: 本文为述评，不提供具体的研究数据或干预效果，而是指出研究的缺失领域。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary and does not provide specific research data or intervention effects, but rather highlights a missing area of research.

items.title: Preliminary Validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Testing Rating Scale for Patients with Voice Disorders
items.summary: A preliminary validation study (N=78 voice disorder patients) of the Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) found that the scale showed emerging content, construct, concurrent, and predictive validity, with two distinct factors and significant prediction of return for voice therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这个刺激性测试量表 MSP-V 的初步验证为评估语音障碍患者的刺激性提供了一个多维工具，有助于更精确地记录和跟踪患者的治疗进展。虽然是语疗领域，但其方法学对康复医学评估工具的开发有借鉴意义。
items.titleZh: 语音障碍患者多维刺激性测试评分量表的初步验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对语音障碍患者（N=78）的语音多维刺激性评估量表（MSP-V）的初步验证研究发现，该量表在内容效度、结构效度、同证效度和预测效度方面表现良好，具有两个独立因子，并能显著预测语音治疗的复诊情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: The preliminary validation of the Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) offers a multidimensional tool for assessing stimulability in patients with voice disorders, facilitating more precise documentation and tracking of patient progress. Although this is in speech-language pathology, its methodology offers insights for the development of rehabilitation assessment tools.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步验证，样本量有限（78 名患者），且语音障碍类型异质，尚需大规模研究进一步验证其在临床实践中的普适性。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary validation study with a limited sample size (78 patients) and heterogeneous voice disorder types, requiring further large-scale validation for generalizability in clinical practice.

items.title: Optimising Pre-race Physical Preparation for Sprint Events at Major Championships Under New Rule Changes and Competition Formats
items.summary: This leading article reviews optimal pre-race physical preparation for sprint events under new rule changes, recommending strategies like same-day priming sessions, passive insulation for muscle temperature maintenance, and brief plyometric or acceleration stimuli 8–16 minutes before race start, while acknowledging limited direct evidence in elite sprinters.
items.curatedReason: 这份述评虽然是专家共识而非实证，但仍对短跑运动员的赛前准备提出了实用的建议。在新的比赛规则下，你可以尝试维持肌肉温度的被动热绝缘，以及赛前 8-16 分钟的短时增强式或加速刺激，但请记住，这在精英短跑运动员中尚缺乏直接证据。
items.titleZh: 新规则和竞赛形式下大型锦标赛短跑项目赛前身体准备的优化
items.summaryZh: 这篇前瞻性文章回顾了新规则下短跑项目赛前身体准备的优化策略，建议采取诸如当日预启动训练、被动保温以维持肌肉温度以及赛前 8-16 分钟的简短增强式或加速刺激等策略，但承认在精英短跑运动员中直接证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: While an expert consensus rather than empirical evidence, this leading article offers practical recommendations for sprinters' pre-race preparation. Under new competition rules, consider passive insulation for muscle temperature and brief plyometric or acceleration stimuli 8–16 minutes before the start, but be aware that direct evidence in elite sprinters is limited.
items.limitation: 本文为综述性述评，基于现有证据和机制理论提出建议，但缺乏直接在精英短跑运动员中模拟大赛情境的实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a leading article based on existing evidence and mechanistic rationale, but lacks direct empirical research simulating major championship demands in elite sprinters.

items.title: Recovery strategies, training volume, and performance in Japanese recreational marathon runners: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 5,204 Japanese recreational marathon runners found that bathing, stretching, hot spring use, and massage were the most common recovery strategies, while specialized modalities were less used. Active recovery, contrast baths, and acupuncture/moxibustion showed modest associations with shorter personal best marathon times and higher monthly training volume.
items.curatedReason: 这项对日本休闲马拉松跑者的调查显示，洗浴、拉伸和按摩是常用的恢复策略，而专业服务的使用率较低。你可以根据这些发现，为你的跑者患者提供更符合其习惯且经济高效的恢复建议。
items.titleZh: 日本休闲马拉松跑者的恢复策略、训练量和表现：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 5,204 名日本休闲马拉松跑者的横断面调查发现，洗浴、拉伸、温泉和按摩是最常用的恢复策略，而专业康复手段使用较少。主动恢复、冷热交替浴以及针灸/艾灸与较短的马拉松个人最好成绩和较高的月训练量有适度关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of Japanese recreational marathon runners indicates that bathing, stretching, and massage are commonly used recovery strategies, with lower utilization of specialized services. You can use these findings to offer more habitual and cost-effective recovery advice to your running patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅能发现恢复策略与训练量和表现之间的关联性，不能确立因果关系；且回复率较低，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, which can only identify associations between recovery strategies, training volume, and performance, but cannot establish causality; the low response rate also suggests potential selection bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Medicare Program; Implementation of Sections 6219, 6220, and 6224 of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (CMS-4214-P)

items.titleZh: Medicare 项目；《2026年综合拨款法案》第6219、6220和6224节的实施（CMS-4214-P）
items.summaryZh: CMS 公布了一项关于实施《2026年综合拨款法案》第6219、6220和6224节的拟议规则，预示着 Medicare 项目运营和支付政策可能发生变化。

items.title: CMS Proposes Reforms to Strengthen Transparency and Affordability in Medicare Advantage and Part D

items.titleZh: CMS 提议改革以加强 Medicare Advantage 和 Part D 的透明度和可负担性

items.title: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal Cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 48 nursing professionals in a spinal cord injury rehabilitation center found 87.5% experienced patient-perpetrated sexual harassment within 12 months, with verbal harassment being the most prevalent and severe.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对脊髓损伤康复中心护士的调查揭示了患者性骚扰的普遍性，其中言语骚扰最为常见且严重。作为物理治疗师，你在执业中与患者的密切接触可能也会面临类似风险，应提高警惕，并在机构层面推动相关培训和支持机制。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤康复中心护士遭受性骚扰的经历
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤康复中心48名护理人员的横断面调查发现，87.5%的受访者在过去12个月内遭受过患者的性骚扰，其中言语性骚扰最为普遍和严重。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey on nurses in a SCI rehabilitation center reveals the prevalence of patient-perpetrated sexual harassment, with verbal harassment being the most common and severe. As a physical therapist, your close contact with patients in practice may also expose you to similar risks; you should be vigilant and advocate for relevant training and support mechanisms at the institutional level.
items.limitation: 本研究为单一中心的横断面调查，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, cross-sectional survey, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: How Sensory and Motor Components Shape the Neurological Level of Injury
items.summary: This study assesses the contributions of light touch, pinprick, and motor function in determining the neurological level of injury (NLI) and how omitting these components affects NLI and ASIA Impairment Scale classification, aiming to inform evidence-based recommendations.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在确定神经损伤平面（NLI）和 ASIA 损伤量表（AIS）分类时，轻触、针刺和运动功能三者缺一不可。任何一项评估的缺失都可能导致不准确的 NLI 和 AIS 分类，所以务必进行全面的感觉和运动评估。
items.titleZh: 感觉和运动成分如何影响神经损伤平面
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了轻触、针刺和运动功能对神经损伤平面（NLI）确定的贡献，以及省略这些成分如何影响NLI和美国脊髓损伤协会（ASIA）损伤量表分类，旨在为循证建议提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that light touch, pinprick, and motor function are all crucial for accurate neurological level of injury (NLI) and ASIA Impairment Scale (AIS) classification. Omitting any one of these assessments may lead to inaccurate NLI and AIS classifications; therefore, comprehensive sensory and motor evaluations are essential.
